sentences.text: Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron is a symbiont of the human gut; gut Bacteroides are metabolic generalists that deploy dozens of polysaccharide utilization loci to forage dietary and host-derived glycans.

A study identified more than 100 genes expressed by Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron during growth on different O-glycan substrates and characterised 33 glycoside hydrolases, of which 13 were sufficient for mucin degradation.
In the same work, competition experiments in vivo showed that several enzymes targeting mucin capping structures are central to gut colonization.
A genome-scale CRISPR interference screen of mucin utilization in this species identified 1,256 genes whose fitness contribution depended on the growth condition.
Deleting the RNA-binding protein RbpB compromised colonization of the mouse gut in a diet-dependent manner.
